title: The Sea Chord & Salt Haus
meta_description: These two bright and beachy condos are just 3 minutes from the beach, featuring private balconies, a community pool, and all the comforts for a perfect coastal getaway.
description_expanded:
Welcome to The Sea Chord \& Salt Haus by AvantStay! These two condos are located on the same floor, each with one bedroom, sleeping a combined total of 9 guests.

The Sea Chord \& Salt Haus are just steps from the sugar-white sands of Walton Dunes Beach Access---a quick 3-minute walk down the street. When you're not lounging at the beach, take advantage of the large, community pool and hot tub, surrounded by sun loungers perfect for soaking up the Florida sunshine. You're also a short walk or bike ride away from nearby shops, restaurants, and experiences. Whether you're here for a quick getaway or an extended stay, these two condos deliver the perfect combination of beach access, comfort, and style---a true coastal haven for families and groups alike.

The Sea Chord:
Welcome to The Sea Chord, a charming one-bedroom, one-bathroom beachside condo along the stunning 30A coastline, offering everything you need for a relaxing escape. Natural light fills the inviting living room, where cozy seating is perfect for movie nights or afternoon naps. The fully equipped kitchen makes beachside breakfasts a breeze, featuring barstool seating for casual dining and everything you need to whip up home-cooked meals. Step onto the private balcony to unwind with refreshing ocean breezes and beautiful Gulf and lake views---there's even a guitar on the wall for strumming along to the sound of the waves. The loft bedroom offers two queen beds for restful nights, while a full bathroom provides space to refresh. A Murphy bed in the living area easily folds down to provide additional sleeping space. The home is complete with in-home laundry, easy parking, and thoughtful extras like card and board games, beach toys, children's toys, and beach chairs to ensure a seamless stay.

Salt Haus:
Fully renovated in 2022, Salt Haus is a one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo that blends thoughtfully curated details, luxury amenities, and a welcoming coastal-chic aesthetic for an effortless beach escape. Step inside to the fully equipped kitchen and bar area, opening into a bright living space with an inviting sofa and Frame TV. Soft whites, light wood, breezy curtains, and organic textures create a calming atmosphere. The living area opens onto a large balcony with beachfront views and ample seating, where you can listen to the waves and breathe in the fresh salt air. Start your morning with a Nespresso in the hanging rattan chair and spend sun-soaked days using the provided beach equipment. The space invites you to enjoy sunset picnics with wine, cook fresh meals with premium cookware, mix cocktails at the bar, or play board games on the couch. When you're ready to unwind, the loft-style bedroom features two queen beds for a restful night, while the full bathroom boasts a walk-in shower and a Dyson hair dryer to pamper yourself.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach, Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- The bedroom is located in the loft and therefore isn't private.
- Salt Haus: This home does not offer a washer and dryer in the unit. However, there is a laundry facility on site, which takes card.
- Please note the elevator at this property is managed by the HOA, not AvantStay.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- There are two parking spaces available for your use. Each booking will receive 2 parking passes, and these must be displayed at all times.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
